voice.meet: I'm BROCK. I train Rock types, and I cook for them too!
voice.heard: So you're {PLAYER}? Word's out! Have you eaten yet?
voice.again: Oh, hi again! Still getting to know each other, huh?
voice.hello: Hey, {PLAYER}! Good to see you. Eating well, I hope?
voice.close: {PLAYER}! Good to see you, friend. There is always a plate for you.
voice.bye: Take care! And keep your POKéMON well fed!

voice.meet: I'm MISTY! My policy? An all-out offensive with Water types!
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? I've heard things. They'd better be true!
voice.again: Oh, it's you again. Fine, I guess I'm getting used to you.
voice.hello: Hey, {PLAYER}! Took you long enough!
voice.close: Hey, {PLAYER}! Best friend alert! Don't tell anyone I said so.
voice.bye: See ya! ...{BUDDY}, get back in your ball! Not again!

voice.meet: Name's LT. SURGE, the Lightning American! Nice to meet ya!
voice.heard: Hey, kid! You're {PLAYER}, right? I heard you're tough!
voice.again: Hey, kid! You again! Starting to grow on me, ya know!
voice.hello: Hey, kid! {PLAYER}! Still standing? Good!
voice.close: Hey there, {PLAYER}! My favorite soldier! At ease, friend!
voice.bye: Dismissed, kid! Stay sharp!

voice.meet: Pleased to meet you. I am ERIKA. I teach flower arranging.
voice.heard: Oh... you are {PLAYER}? I have heard such lovely things.
voice.again: Oh, hello again. I remember you. Please, relax a while.
voice.hello: Oh... {PLAYER}? Forgive me, I was nearly asleep. Hello!
voice.close: Dear {PLAYER}. Your company is a joy. Please, stay a moment.
voice.bye: Farewell. Oh... I think I'll close my eyes a moment...

voice.meet: I'm JANINE, daughter of KOGA, and a ninja in training!
voice.heard: Fufufu! You're {PLAYER}! My spies told me all about you!
voice.again: Fufufu! You again! I'm starting to see through you!
voice.hello: Fufufufu... Surprised? It's just me! Hello, {PLAYER}!
voice.close: {PLAYER}! Fufufu, there's no need to hide from you anymore!
voice.bye: Farewell! (Poof!) ...I'm still working on that part.

voice.meet: I am SABRINA. I have had psychic powers since childhood.
voice.heard: You are {PLAYER}. Your name reached me before you did.
voice.again: We meet again. I remember you. That is rare.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. I foresaw that you would come.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. I see you clearly now. You are a true friend.
voice.bye: We will meet again. I have seen it.

voice.meet: Hah! I am BLAINE! Quizmaster and red-hot Fire trainer!
voice.heard: Hah! You're {PLAYER}! Heard you're a real hot shot!
voice.again: Hah! Back again! You're getting to be a familiar face!
voice.hello: Hah! {PLAYER}! Got your BURN HEAL handy?
voice.close: Hah! {PLAYER}, my friend! Always a hot time with you!
voice.bye: Hah! Better have BURN HEAL next time!

voice.meet: I am GIOVANNI. Remember the name. Others have learned to.
voice.heard: So. You are {PLAYER}. I have heard your name. Often.
voice.again: You again. I am beginning to remember your face.
voice.hello: So. {PLAYER}. You keep turning up.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. You have earned my trust. Do not waste it.
voice.bye: Go. We will meet again.

voice.meet: I'm BLUE! Remember it, 'cause I'm the best there is!
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? Everyone's talking about you. Not me, though.
voice.again: Oh, you again. Keep this up and I'll remember you!
voice.hello: Yo, {PLAYER}! Miss me? Course you did.
voice.close: Yo, {PLAYER}! My rival and my friend. Don't let it go to your head.
voice.bye: Smell ya later!

voice.meet: I am LORELEI. No one can best me with icy POKéMON.
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? I have heard so much about you.
voice.again: Ah, you again. I am beginning to know you.
voice.hello: Ah, {PLAYER}. Come to see me? How refreshing.
voice.close: Dear {PLAYER}. I am truly glad to see you. Stay a while.
voice.bye: Come along, {BUDDY}. Until next time.

voice.meet: I am BRUNO! I train with my POKéMON, body and soul!
voice.heard: Hoo hah! You are {PLAYER}! I have heard of your strength!
voice.again: Hoo hah! You again! Your face is familiar now!
voice.hello: Hoo hah! {PLAYER}! Still training hard?
voice.close: Hoo hah! {PLAYER}! My friend! Our bond is strong as steel!
voice.bye: Train hard! Hoo hah!

voice.meet: I am AGATHA. Remember that name, child. OAK surely does.
voice.heard: Hmph. So you're {PLAYER}. I've heard the rumors, child.
voice.again: Hmph. You again, child. You're persistent, I'll give you that.
voice.hello: Hmph. {PLAYER}. Still kicking, are you?
voice.close: Hmph. {PLAYER}. Fine, you're all right, child. Don't tell anyone.
voice.bye: Off with you, child. {BUDDY} and I have things to do.

voice.meet: I am KOGA. I live in shadows, a ninja!
voice.heard: Fwahaha! You are {PLAYER}. My shadows spoke of you.
voice.again: Fwahaha! You again. Your steps are familiar to me now.
voice.hello: Fwahahaha! {PLAYER}. You did not sense me, did you?
voice.close: Fwahaha! {PLAYER}. I trust few. You are one of them.
voice.bye: Until our paths cross again. Fwahahaha!

voice.meet: I'm LANCE, a trainer of dragons. It's a pleasure.
voice.heard: So you're {PLAYER}. Your name has reached even me.
voice.again: Good to see you again. I'm glad our paths crossed.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. Good to see you. You're looking strong.
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My friend. It's always good to see you.
voice.bye: Until next time. {BUDDY}, let's go!

voice.meet: I'm FALKNER. I carry on my father's work with bird POKéMON.
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? My father would want to hear of you!
voice.again: Oh, hello again! We keep running into each other, don't we?
voice.hello: {PLAYER}! Good timing. My birds are itching to fly.
voice.close: {PLAYER}! You're a true friend. My birds love you, too!
voice.bye: Take care! Keep your spirits soaring!

voice.meet: I'm BUGSY! I never lose when it comes to Bug POKéMON!
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? I've read about you! Can I study you?
voice.again: Hi again! I'm starting to learn your habits. For research!
voice.hello: Hi, {PLAYER}! Seen any interesting Bug POKéMON lately?
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My best research partner! I saved you a note!
voice.bye: Bye! If you spot a rare bug, tell me first!

voice.meet: Hi! I'm WHITNEY! Everyone got into POKéMON, so I did too!
voice.heard: Wait, you're {PLAYER}? Everyone's talking about you!
voice.again: Hiii again! I remember you! We should hang out more!
voice.hello: Hiii, {PLAYER}! I'm so glad to see you!
voice.close: {PLAYER}! Yay! You're my bestest friend! Come on, hang out!
voice.bye: Bye-bye! Call me sometime, 'kay?

voice.meet: I'm MORTY. I train to see what others cannot.
voice.heard: You are {PLAYER}. I saw your name in a vision.
voice.again: We meet again. I sense we will grow close.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. I had a feeling you'd come.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. I see a bright bond between us. I'm glad you came.
voice.bye: Until we meet again. Keep your eyes open.

voice.meet: I'm CHUCK! My POKéMON crush stones and shatter bones!
voice.heard: WAHAHAH! You're {PLAYER}! I heard you've got guts!
voice.again: WAHAHAH! You again! I'm getting used to that face!
voice.hello: WAHAHAH! {PLAYER}! Good to see you, buddy!
voice.close: WAHAHAH! {PLAYER}! My buddy! Pals train together, right?
voice.bye: See you! Keep training! Hah!

voice.meet: Um... I'm JASMINE. I use... the Steel type. Nice to meet you.
voice.heard: Um... you're {PLAYER}? I have... heard about you.
voice.again: Oh... um... hello again. I remember you.
voice.hello: Oh... {PLAYER}. Um... hello. It's nice to see you.
voice.close: {PLAYER}... I'm so happy to see you. You're my friend.
voice.bye: Goodbye... Please take care.

voice.meet: I am PRYCE. I've been with POKéMON since before you were born.
voice.heard: Hm. So you're {PLAYER}. Even an old man hears the talk.
voice.again: Ah, you again. An old man remembers a good face.
voice.hello: Ah, {PLAYER}. Good. An old man enjoys some company.
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My dear friend. An old man treasures such company.
voice.bye: Go on, then. Don't keep your POKéMON waiting.

voice.meet: I am CLAIR. The world's best dragon master.
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? Hmph. I've heard. Don't get cocky.
voice.again: You again? Hmph. I suppose I'm used to you now.
voice.hello: Oh, it's you, {PLAYER}. Hmph. Fine, I'll say hello.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. Hmph. Fine, you're a friend. Don't make it weird.
voice.bye: Go on. And don't tell LANCE I was nice to you.

voice.meet: I am WILL. I have trained all around the world.
voice.heard: So you are {PLAYER}. Your name has reached me, mask and all.
voice.again: We meet again. I am beginning to know you.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. We meet again. As expected.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. I trust you more than most. Do not tell anyone.
voice.bye: Farewell. Do not keep me waiting next time.

voice.meet: I'm KAREN. I use Dark types. Remember that.
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? I've heard you trust your POKéMON.
voice.again: Oh, you again. You're growing on me. A little.
voice.hello: Oh, {PLAYER}. Good. I was getting bored.
voice.close: Oh, {PLAYER}. Good. I really did hope you'd come.
voice.bye: Go on. Keep battling with your favorites.

voice.meet: I'm ROXANNE. I study POKéMON battles, and I love to teach!
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? Your name is in all my notes!
voice.again: Hello again! I remember you. Your progress is fascinating!
voice.hello: Hello, {PLAYER}! Ready for another lesson?
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My favorite student! I kept a page for you!
voice.bye: Goodbye! Don't forget to review your notes!

voice.meet: I'm BRAWLY! Fighting and surfing, that's my whole deal!
voice.heard: Dude, you're {PLAYER}? Everyone's buzzing about you!
voice.again: Hey, you again! Getting to know you is a total wave!
voice.hello: Hey, {PLAYER}! Totally stoked to see you!
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My bro! Always stoked to ride with you!
voice.bye: Later! Stay stoked!

voice.meet: Wahahahah! I'm WATTSON! Old, but still full of sparks!
voice.heard: Wahahahah! You're {PLAYER}! I heard you're a live wire!
voice.again: Wahahahah! You again! Your face is getting familiar!
voice.hello: Wahahahah! {PLAYER}! You look fully charged!
voice.close: Wahahahah! {PLAYER}! My dear friend! You light me up!
voice.bye: Wahahahah! Off you go! Stay charged!

voice.meet: I'm FLANNERY! My grandfather taught me all about fire!
voice.heard: Wait, you're {PLAYER}? Gramps told me all about you!
voice.again: Oh, hi again! I'm starting to get to know you!
voice.hello: Oh, {PLAYER}! Hi! I mean... Ahem. Greetings!
voice.close: {PLAYER}! You're my friend! I can be myself with you!
voice.bye: See you! Stay fired up!

voice.meet: I'm NORMAN. A GYM LEADER, but a father first.
voice.heard: So you're {PLAYER}. I've heard a lot about you.
voice.again: Ah, hello again. I'm glad to see you back.
voice.hello: Ah, {PLAYER}. Good to see you. Keeping strong?
voice.close: {PLAYER}. You're like family. I am always glad to see you.
voice.bye: Take care. And keep training hard.

voice.meet: I am WINONA. I have become one with bird POKéMON.
voice.heard: You are {PLAYER}? Word of you has travelled far.
voice.again: Ah, hello again. I remember you well.
voice.hello: Hello, {PLAYER}. It's always a pleasure.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. I'm truly glad of your company, dear friend.
voice.bye: Farewell. May you soar ever higher.

voice.meet: TATE: I'm TATE! LIZA: And I'm LIZA! We're twins!
voice.heard: TATE: You're {PLAYER}! LIZA: We've heard all about you!
voice.again: TATE: Oh, it's you again! LIZA: We remember you!
voice.hello: TATE: Hey, {PLAYER}! LIZA: We knew you'd come!
voice.close: TATE: {PLAYER}! LIZA: Our best friend! We're so happy!
voice.bye: TATE: See you... LIZA: ...later!

voice.meet: I am JUAN. It was I who taught WALLACE all he knows.
voice.heard: Ah, you are {PLAYER}! Your fame precedes you.
voice.again: Ah, hello again! Our paths cross gracefully.
voice.hello: Ah, {PLAYER}. How delightful to see you again.
voice.close: Ah, dear {PLAYER}! My friend! What a delight!
voice.bye: Farewell! Go forth with elegance!

voice.meet: I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR. Let's enjoy ourselves, huh?
voice.heard: Hey, you're {PLAYER}? I've heard you're a blast!
voice.again: Hey, it's you again! I like where this is going!
voice.hello: Hey, {PLAYER}! I like that look you're giving me!
voice.close: Hey, {PLAYER}! My partner in trouble! Let's have a blast!
voice.bye: Later! Let's have another blast sometime!

voice.meet: Ahahaha! I'm PHOEBE! I can commune with Ghost POKéMON!
voice.heard: Ahahaha! You're {PLAYER}! The ghosts whispered your name!
voice.again: Ahahaha! You again! The ghosts remember you, too!
voice.hello: Ahahaha! {PLAYER}! Hi! The ghosts said you'd drop by!
voice.close: Ahahaha! {PLAYER}! My friend! Even the ghosts adore you!
voice.bye: Bye-bye! Ahahaha! Watch out for ghosts!

voice.meet: I am GLACIA. I traveled from afar to hone my icy skills.
voice.heard: So you are {PLAYER}. I have heard of you. Barely.
voice.again: You again. I may remember you after all.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. So you've come. I hope you won't bore me.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. You do not bore me. I count that as friendship.
voice.bye: Go. Come back when you're worth the chill.

voice.meet: I am DRAKE. I raise dragons. Do you know what that takes?
voice.heard: You are {PLAYER}. Sailors speak of you. Rumors, at least.
voice.again: You again. I am beginning to take note of you.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}. Good. You've still got fire in your eyes.
voice.close: {PLAYER}. A friend of dragons is a friend of mine.
voice.bye: Go. And keep your heart strong.

voice.meet: Allow me to present myself. I am WALLACE. Elegance is my art.
voice.heard: Ah, you are {PLAYER}! Your reputation is quite elegant.
voice.again: Ah, hello again! I do remember you fondly.
voice.hello: Ah, {PLAYER}. Elegant as ever, I see.
voice.close: Dear {PLAYER}! A friend as elegant as you is rare.
voice.bye: Farewell! May your style shine ever brighter.

voice.meet: I'm STEVEN. I'm crazy about rare stones. Nice to meet you.
voice.heard: You're {PLAYER}? I've heard of you! Like a rare gem!
voice.again: Oh, hello again! Good to see you back.
voice.hello: {PLAYER}! Good to see you. Found any rare stones?
voice.close: {PLAYER}! My friend! I saved you a special stone to see.
voice.bye: I'll see you around. Take care.
